name: totp-auth
title: Authenticator (TOTP)
description: A per-chat TOTP authenticator (RFC 6238) via /otp slash commands: add accounts with Base32 secrets (/otp add <label> <secret>), generate current 6-8 digit codes with SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 support, list accounts with countdown (/otp list, /otp code), export standard otpauth:// URIs (/otp uri) that pair with the qr-tools module, and remove accounts behind a two-step confirm (/otp remove + /otp confirm). Secrets never leave the device — the module has NO network permission at all; everything lives in per-chat storage so another chat cannot see the accounts.
